title: The Burial of Christ
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: The burial of Christ means that Jesus truly died and was placed in the tomb. His burial confirms the reality of His death and stands between the cross and the bodily resurrection.
summary: The burial of Christ means that Jesus truly died and was placed in the tomb. His burial confirms the reality of His death and stands between the cross and the bodily resurrection.
christFocus: Jesus entered the grave for His people. His burial shows that He truly passed into death, and His resurrection shows that death could not hold Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The burial of Christ is part of the Gospel Paul received and delivered. Christ died for sins, was buried, and was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures.

His burial confirms that His death was real. Jesus did not merely appear to die, faint, or symbolically suffer. His body was taken down, wrapped, and laid in a tomb.

The burial also prepares the way for the resurrection. The same Jesus who was laid in the grave rose bodily from the dead, showing victory over death itself.

Believers are united with Christ in His death and burial, and they are raised to walk in newness of life. His burial is not a minor detail; it belongs to the saving pattern of death and resurrection.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Some may overlook the burial as only a historical note, but Scripture includes it in the Gospel summary. It anchors Christian hope in a real death and a real resurrection.

This doctrine helps believers face death honestly. Christ truly entered the grave, and because He rose, the grave is not the final word for those who belong to Him.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Remember that Jesus truly entered death for His people. Do not treat the resurrection as a vague symbol of renewal. Trust the crucified, buried, and risen Christ, and walk in the new life He gives.
